mainEntity.name: Will AI really save time, or will I spend all day fixing its mistakes?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can reduce repeated drafting and information-gathering work, but it does not remove the need for strategy, review, customer judgment, or maintenance. The most realistic benefit is a more organized starting point and fewer manual steps, not a fully unattended business.

Context: Run My AI Biz covers planning, products, marketing, funnels, publishing, scheduling, and administration while stressing owner direction. The examples distinguish possible applications from proven outcomes.

Key factors:
- Whether the task is genuinely repetitive
- Quality of available information
- Time required for review
- Frequency of workflow changes

Practical guidance: Estimate the full current effort, then compare it with AI preparation plus review and correction. Stop or redesign the workflow if the net work does not improve.

Run My AI Biz helps owners evaluate practical workload changes instead of promising passive income.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can save time on repetitive research, drafting, and organization, but only when review and correction take less effort than the original task. Measure the complete workflow and redesign or stop it if AI creates more work than it removes.
